title: Require SDK Server Effect Facade Source
forbids: a Habitat-authored server Effect runner, ManagedRuntime ownership, direct handlerGen use, or an SDK server Effect facade with behavior beyond loading the official extension
why: The terminal SDK may hide the one official Effect-oRPC bootstrap, but neither its server face nor the runtime plugin definition may become a second execution bridge or runtime owner.
remediate: Keep plugins/server/effect/index.ts to the one official extension side-effect import plus an empty export. Remove direct handlerGen use, ManagedRuntime imports, Effect execution terminals, helpers, and extra side effects from the SDK server authoring face and runtime plugin definition.
message: The SDK server face and runtime plugin definition must delegate Effect execution and admit no ManagedRuntime ownership.
